_comment: Which ledger account each Apple Wallet card belongs to. First matching rule wins. name_contains is compared without case or accents against the card name Wallet shows; last4 (optional) must equal the card's last 4 digits. account may use {currency}. foreign_account is used when the purchase currency is not the card's home_currency. account null = ignore that card (e.g. the Bancolombia debit card: its purchases already come from the savings statement and alert emails). Cards that match no rule are skipped and listed in the sync summary.
